title: Aetherium: Godot trading card game
summary: A Godot 4.6 collectible card game: duels against a computer opponent (rules-based, or through a local model when one is running), draw, preparation, combat and main phases, mana that grows each turn, stage 2 and 3 evolutions, about 600 playable cards with their abilities (damage, heal, buff, debuff, life steal, bounce, destroy, draw, auras, traps and more), a card inspector, and a deck manager. Aetherium began from the open-source CCG Engine Template; every part of that has since been replaced, so the royalty covers the whole template, code and card content alike.
works: Opens and imports in Godot 4.6 with no script errors, and boots to the main menu (checked with Godot 4.6 stable).

Two computer players finish full matches on the real board: Tools/smoke_match.tscn runs one headless and prints the result. Six matches of 7 to 17 turns ran clean for this release, each seat winning some.
All 605 playable cards load, with blank placeholder faces where the card art goes. Turn buffs are taken back exactly at the end of the turn (Tools/rules_check.tscn).
unfinished: Card art, music and the main menu's button art are not included: cards show a blank placeholder face and the menu plays no music until you add your own (see Not included).
About a dozen card names come from other games (RuneScape and Pokémon). Rename them before any commercial use.
The deck manager lists, opens, creates, renames and deletes decks, but picking cards into a deck isn't built yet; duels use a generated starter deck.
The opponent's chat calls Ollama at localhost:11434 with qwen3:4b; using LM Studio needs a small change to Scripts/AI/OllamaClient.gd.
Balance, rules text and the computer's play have not been tuned at length, and the person at the board has only been tested by hand, not automatically.
No online play and no export presets.
notIncluded: Card art (assets/card_textures/, about 670 MB), kept for the Aetherium card set. Each card refers to res://assets/card_textures/<name>.png or .jpg: replace the placeholders with art of the same name, or point the cards at your own.
Music (assets/audio/music/): Dillan Copeland's original soundtrack is not part of the template.

Third-party art packs the game used, whose licenses do not allow passing the files on: Free Hologram Interface by Wenrexa (main menu buttons, free on itch.io), Lightning VFX by Frostwindz, and 16x16 effect and bullet sprites. Get your own copies from their authors.
The old JSON card database (data/), which the game no longer uses.
requirements: Optional: Ollama, for the opponent to talk and play through a local model
openWith: Open Godot 4.6, choose Import, and pick project.godot in this folder. Godot rebuilds its import cache the first time (a minute or two). Run the project to reach the main menu.
